title: Portuguese-Style Fish Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Portugal, traditionally made with fish and potatoes. This recipe serves 4-6 people.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large, heavy pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they're translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes, fish stock, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the cod fillets to the stew and cook for an additional 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice, if desired.
